senses.gloss:
फुल्ल् {c1c} P. (फुल्लति, फुल्लित)
1 To
bloom, expand, blow, open (as a
flower).
--2 To swell, expand;
Māl. 5. 23.

फुल्ल p. p. (of फल्)
1 Expanded,
opened, blown; पुष्पं च फुल्लं
नवमल्लिकायाः प्रयाति कांतिं प्रमदाजतानां Rs. 6. 6;
फुल्लारविंदवदनां Ch. P. 1.
--2
Flowering, blossomed; R. 9. 63.
--3
[]
Expanded, dilated, wide opened (as
eyes).
--4 Smiling, gay.
--ल्ल A
fullblown flower.
--Comp.
--तुवरी alum.
--नयन, --नेत्र --लोचन a. having eyes
dilated (with joy); Pt. 1. 136.
--(नः) a kind of deer.
--(नं) a large,
full eye.
--फालः the wind raised in
winnowing corn.
